newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via three-day fixed system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via three-day fixed system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added temporary reserves to the banking system Monday via three-day fixed system repurchase agreements, a Fed spokesman said.

The Fed entered the market about an hour before its usual intervention time. By the time of the intervention at 1030 EST/1530 GMT, federal funds were traded at 5-1/4 percent, in line with the Fed's target.
Analysts said the market is still expecting the Fed to add permanent reserves to the banking system through a coupon pass operation soon, but not necessarily on Monday.
